name: Infercom Inference Service
description: European inference service with a finite free credit.
overview: Infercom advertises €5 in API credits on signup, no card, expiring after 90 days. The no-payment Free tier has access to production models with per-model rate limits; the published table lists GPT OSS 120B and Gemma 4 31B at 20 requests per day. It is a separate Infercom service from the existing SambaNova listing; no signup or inference was tested.
free_access: Free tier has per-model request limits
notes: Base URL https://api.infercom.ai/v1. Confirm remaining credit and current production model limits.
